g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Amazon SageMaker MLOps with a private Studio, Pipelines and a real-time endpoint

g.title: None.None.Node.28
g.text: Data scientists connect through Client VPN
to SageMaker Studio, which runs in VPC-only mode with no internet access
Notebooks call SageMaker through the interface endpoint
to define and fill feature groups in Feature Store
An EventBridge Scheduler schedule starts the Step Functions workflow each week
The pipeline trains on offline features and the training data in S3
and registers the evaluated model in the Model Registry
Once the version is approved, the workflow updates the endpoint with a blue/green deployment
The customer app calls the predictions API
API Gateway invokes a Lambda function in the VPC
which calls the SageMaker runtime through its interface endpoint
and the real-time endpoint returns the score
